confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Beijing price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel rates vary by district and by July demand and are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the local draft beer price (about five and four times), because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Large Chinese metropolis: beer, coffee and meal anchors are based on general price levels in major Chinese cities; lodging anchors are based on mid-range East Asian capital cities.
